Method of Attack: Uses bcdedit to turn off Windows Startup Repair
Uses RC4 encryption for communication with Command & Control servers
Creates victim unique identifier from MD5 hash of computer name, volume serial number, processor info, and OS version
Delivered via JavaScript Trojan/Downloader in zipped email attachments pretending to be resumes
Attack Vector: Zipped email attachments containing JavaScript files that download and execute the ransomware
